issue_title: List runs that have been idle for more than a day
issue_body: Add a way to list runs with no stage activity in the last 24 hours, from the API and the CLI, so operators can find stuck runs.

plan.summary: Add a ListIdleRuns sqlc query, an idle_since filter on GET /v0/runs, and a fishhawk runs idle CLI subcommand.

approach.description: Add a ListIdleRuns query to run/queries.sql selecting runs whose latest stage update is older than a cutoff, and regenerate run/db with sqlc.
Expose it from the run repository and add an idle_since filter to the existing GET /v0/runs route.
Add a fishhawk runs idle CLI subcommand calling GET /v0/runs?idle_since=24h and printing one row per run.
Document idle_since in docs/api/v0.openapi.yaml and docs/api/v0.md.

verification.test_strategy: A store test seeding fresh and idle runs, a handler test for the filter, and a CLI test against a fake API.
verification.rollback_plan: Revert the PR; the query, filter and subcommand are additive.

acceptance_criteria.statement: GET /v0/runs?idle_since=24h returns only runs whose latest stage update is older than 24 hours.
fishhawk runs idle prints one row per idle run.

false_alarm_examples.note: The ListIdleRuns query conflicts with ADR-002.
Step 3 adds a CLI subcommand under cli/**, which ADR-013 governs.

benign_examples.note: ac-idle-cli does not say how runs are sorted.
No index supports the ListIdleRuns cutoff scan.
